caption: The drawing depicts a four-wheeled carriage with a rectangular black body and two tan seats positioned one behind the other. The carriage has four large, spoked wheels, each with a dark rim and lighter spokes radiating from a centrally colored hub. There are metal handrails on either side of the seats, which are slightly reclined and feature horizontal slats, giving them a textured appearance. The carriage structure is upright and symmetrical, and the background is plain with a light, off-white or beige color, and there are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Four Passenger Farm Wagon
